panels.description: Current panels show the latest DQ verdict and reasons for the selected pipeline. Selected-run panels use HTTP-backed identity and record accounting; run ID never filters Prometheus. Selected-range panels show scores, freshness, rejects, and delivery impact. These scopes answer different questions and must not be compared as equivalent status signals. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser. Effective filters: stage=${stage}.

options.content: Is data conformant, and what impact needs action? CURRENT = Status/reasons (up to 5). SELECTED RUN = accounting. TIME RANGE scopes are not peers.

panels.title: Monitor Current DQ Status
panels.description: CURRENT · Current DQ verdict for the selected pipeline. Mapping: `0=OK`, `1=WARN`, `2=CRIT`, `3/null=UNKNOWN`. UNKNOWN means current status evidence is missing, stale, unavailable, or not started—not healthy. Run type and stage mainly affect range evidence; run ID does not filter this verdict. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges.

options.content: OK: review run accounting. WARN/CRIT: inspect reasons. UNKNOWN: verify DQ metrics, freshness and source.

panels.description: Start with Current DQ Status, Threshold State, and Current Reasons. For CRIT, inspect validation, anomaly, quarantine, and reject blockers before replay. For WARN, inspect threshold and freshness evidence. If blocked/quarantine/rejects > 0, use accounting with denominators in the Run/Range lanes. Selected-run forensics stay in Run Explorer; resume stays on Trust Review First Recovery Action. Range cards are SLA/freshness context only, not peer severity. Use selected-run accounting and selected-range evidence as supporting lanes, not competing verdicts.

TIME RANGE · CURRENT · Current DQ threshold state for the selected pipeline. Mapping: `0=OK`, `1=WARN`, `2=CRIT`, `null=UNKNOWN`. Hard-fail reasons map to CRIT, warning-only reasons map to WARN. Disabled or noop DQ monitoring is treated as WARN, not unconditional green. This is pipeline-wide; use selected-range panels below for scoped evidence. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges.
panels.title: Monitor DQ Threshold State

panels.description: CURRENT · Current: Bounded reason and action rows for WARN/CRIT (up to 5). If a non-OK current status has no active reason series, a fail-safe reason_evidence_unavailable row directs the operator to verify recording rules. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. An OK status adds No active reasons (OK). UNKNOWN or absent status adds Evidence unavailable (UNKNOWN). Query errors remain Grafana errors.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — reason evidence unavailable; verify DQ metrics and recording rules.

panels.title: Inspect Current DQ Reasons
Review Selected Run Status
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved evidence for the exact Run ID. Completion age and chart range do not change this verdict. CURRENT uses fresh telemetry and retains its 15-minute freshness rule. Historical Trust never authorizes replay now. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is QUERY ERROR. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query; backend down is QUERY ERROR. Chart coverage is separate: use Set range to run in Run Explorer to inspect a partial or outside range. Inspect the report for rules, revision, completion and the saved source evidence.

panels.title: Selected Run · Identity & Accounting
panels.description: Expand after selecting an exact Run ID for HTTP-backed identity and accounting evidence.

panels.title: Inspect Run Identity
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: Compact identity table showing Run ID, Manifest ID, Provider.Entity [Version], Contract [Schema], Execution, Replay [Capability.Mode], Checkpoint [Anchors], and Identity Health. Exact selected run_id wins; aggregate pipeline scope without exact run_id must not guess one manifest identity. No data/datasource errors mean the BioETL Ops HTTP backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting as expected empty. Fail-closed: timeout, empty, or unresolved identity must render UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/NO DATA — never a synthetic healthy zero. Inspect value opens full identifiers as selectable plain text.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first.

panels.title: Inspect Processed Records
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · TIME RANGE · Selected run: Bronze/Silver/Gold stage/outcome accounting evidence for the shared pipeline/run_type context. Uses bounded stage/outcome accounting recording rules; missing accounting series render UNKNOWN/no data, not OK. Summary status, accounted subtotal, and delta rows are intentionally not displayed in this compact table; use Status and detailed recording rules for verdict/delta triage. No data/datasource errors mean the BioETL Ops HTTP backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting as expected empty. Fail-closed: timeout, empty, or unresolved identity must render UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/NO DATA — never a synthetic healthy zero. Counts and percentages are neutral accounting quantities, not quality verdicts. Exclusions alone have no severity threshold here; assess the DQ verdict and contract evidence. Percentages use the same precision (at least one decimal, up to three for small shares).

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run in Inspect Recent Runs.

panels.title: Selected Range · Impact & Freshness
panels.description: Expand for selected-range impact and freshness after resolving the current reason lane.

options.content: **Measured data only · last 7 days.** Record count below is the score denominator; entity count is observed score coverage, not expected coverage. DQ validation time is not recorded by these metrics. Data freshness is separate. Run ID does not filter these scores; 100% does not prove current completeness.

panels.title: Monitor Weighted DQ
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected range: Latest volume-weighted DQ score retained for up to 7 days between runs on the canonical 0.0-1.0 ratio scale, where 1.0 means all records are valid. UNKNOWN means no matching score and record-count samples exist in that window; absence is never coerced to 0. Review raw sample history in the adjacent trend panel. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges.

panels.title: Monitor Worst DQ
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected range: Latest pipeline-scoped worst-entity DQ score retained for up to 7 days between runs on the canonical 0.0-1.0 ratio scale, where 1.0 means all records are valid. UNKNOWN means no matching validation score sample exists in that window, not a successful run and not a zero score. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges.

TIME RANGE · Worst age in hours at the selected range end, using the latest timestamp observed per series within that range. Missing series remain UNKNOWN; an older non-null age is never carried forward. SLA 24/72: WARN at 24h and CRIT at 72h apply only to observed evidence. This is range evidence, not a selected-run or CURRENT completeness verdict.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — no bioetl_data_freshness_seconds for scope

panels.title: Monitor Worst Freshness Age
Inspect DQ Sample Coverage
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Observed coverage over the fixed 7d score lookback. Not expected coverage; missing telemetry remains UNKNOWN.

TIME RANGE delivery impact: Blocked-record evidence. Counts Silver filter rejects plus DQ quarantine records for the pipeline/run_type window without applying entity YAML thresholds. Read alongside the adjacent Track: Source Records in Range (Bronze) panel for denominator context, and rely on Monitor DQ Current Status / Monitor DQ Threshold State for the soft/hard severity verdict instead of the absolute count. 0 means no blocked records were observed in the selected window. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Role: blocked = Silver filtered_out (panel 117) plus DQ quarantine; do not treat 117 and 154 as the same KPI.
panels.title: Monitor Blocked Records

panels.description: TIME RANGE delivery impact: Quarantine count. Non-zero means records were withheld from normal promotion and require quarantine triage even when Silver filter rejects remain zero; 0 means no quarantined records were reported in the selected window. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.
panels.title: Monitor Quarantined Records
Monitor Silver Filter Rejects
panels.description: TIME RANGE delivery impact: Silver structural reject count from the filtered_out path only. FILTERED_OUT_SILVER is a legacy alias for this Silver structural path and is not a Gold contract/semantic reject code. A zero here does not refute current CRIT because quarantine, Gold reject outcomes, and Silver validation blockers are separate paths; use first-screen DQ reasons and the quarantine/validation/Gold panels before assuming the incident is filter-driven. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING. Role: Silver filtered_out rejects only — not the blocked-records superset in Monitor Blocked Records (154).

panels.title: Selected Range · Reject Evidence
panels.description: Expand for selected-range reject evidence; empty is not automatically healthy.

TIME RANGE · Selected range: Silver structural reject reconciliation signal. Non-zero means the stage-total filtered_out counter diverges from the bounded Silver reject breakdown metric over the selected range. Gold contract and semantic reject outcomes are excluded from this guardrail. Zero or empty means none observed, not started, or not available—not bare success. Red only for validated failure. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.
panels.title: Monitor Silver Reject Mismatch

defaults.noValue: No reject reason samples in range

panels.title: Inspect Top Silver Reject Reasons
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected range: Silver structural reject reasons ranked by count in the selected range. Gold contract and semantic rejects are excluded. No data means no bounded reason samples were observed; it must not create a synthetic reason. For record-level evidence run `bioetl quarantine inspect --pipeline <pipeline> --silver-filter-only` with the relevant run/reason filters. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.

defaults.noValue: No reject field samples in range

panels.title: Inspect Top Silver Reject Fields
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected range: Silver structural rejects grouped by schema field in the selected range. Gold contract and semantic rejects are excluded. No data means no bounded field samples were observed. For record-level evidence use `bioetl quarantine inspect` with the relevant pipeline, run, and field filters. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.

TIME RANGE · Selected range: Pipeline breakdown of Silver structural rejects from the filtered_out stage-total counter. This is a scope/distribution panel, not a reason_code summary, and it intentionally excludes Gold contract/semantic rejects. No data means no filtered_out samples were observed in the active window; the panel must not invent a synthetic pipeline row. Current verdict, selected-run accounting, and selected-range evidence are not peer severity badges. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.
panels.title: Inspect Silver Rejects by Pipeline

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Gold contract quarantine and semantic exclusion outcomes by pipeline in the selected range. These are separate from Silver structural FILTERED_OUT_SILVER rejects. Use this panel when DQ impact is not explained by Silver reject evidence. No data means no Gold reject outcome samples were observed. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.

defaults.noValue: No Gold reject samples in range

panels.title: Monitor Gold Records

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected-range Bronze denominator for DQ triage. 0 means no Bronze records were observed inside the active window; it does not prove DQ metrics are missing. Compare with Gold output and blocked-share panels below TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.
panels.title: Monitor Bronze Records

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Latest successful data timestamp for the selected pipeline scope. This is current freshness context and compact supporting evidence rather than a first-answer verdict or selected-range proof. UNKNOWN means no freshness proof is available now; next action: inspect DQ Current Reasons and the DQ investigation runbook before treating stale or blank values as healthy
panels.title: Inspect Latest Successful Data

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Quarantined records grouped by error type in the selected range. Use it to identify dominant quarantine signatures. No data means no matching quarantine samples were observed; it must not create a synthetic error type. For row-level evidence use `bioetl quarantine inspect`. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.
panels.title: Inspect Quarantine Error Types

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected-range count of canonical Silver validation failures. Non-zero means Silver validation blocked or degraded promotion and should be correlated with current DQ reasons and reject/quarantine evidence. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.
panels.title: Monitor Silver Validation Failures

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected-range Gold strict-validation hard-fail count. Non-zero means Gold promotion was blocked. Zero means no hard-fail samples were observed in the selected window; it does not prove Gold validation ran or that Gold output exists. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.
panels.title: Monitor Gold Validation Failures

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected-range anomaly counts by severity and anomaly type. WARN-only anomalies indicate drift; CRIT anomalies are blocking and should be correlated with current DQ reasons before replay or promotion. No data means no anomaly events were observed in the current window; the panel must not invent a synthetic severity/type series. Dense legend is hidden by default; full identifiers remain available in the tooltip/detail row TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Rolling-window samples overlap; legend Last is the last observed window, not an event total for the selected time range.

defaults.noValue: No anomaly samples in range; telemetry may be absent

panels.title: Track DQ Anomalies

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected-range p95 duration of DQ checks. This is a diagnostics/performance surface, not a quality outcome; use it when DQ checks themselves look slow or noisy during an incident. Samples exist only when the runtime emitted bioetl_dq_check_duration_ms, which requires an active DQ monitor path rather than disabled/noop monitoring. No data means no DQ duration samples were observed in range or DQ timing telemetry is absent; it is not equivalent to fast checks. Dense legend is hidden by default; full identifiers remain available in the tooltip/detail row TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Histogram generation guard: windows with a changed producer creation timestamp are omitted for the whole aggregate. A repeated batch snapshot is not a continuous counter; narrow the window to one stable generation. Omitted values do not mean zero latency.

defaults.noValue: NO OBSERVATIONS — no usable histogram increments
